deal_description: Monday Margaritas & Tacos special all day. Featuring discounted classic margaritas and select taco options. Choose from chicken, beef, or fish tacos served with fresh toppings, salsa, and lime. Classic lime margaritas made with premium tequila. Dine-in only. Available at both North & West locations.

Tuesday wings at 50% off starting at 2pm until close. Choose from classic, breaded, or boneless wings tossed in your choice of sauce: honey garlic, BBQ, hot, medium, mild, teriyaki, salt & pepper, or Thai chili. Served with celery, carrots, and ranch or blue cheese dip. Order by the pound or in baskets. Dine-in or takeout. Available at both North & West locations.

Thursday wine special - 50% off all wines by the glass or bottle all day. Selection includes reds (Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Pinot Noir), whites (Chardonnay, Pinot Grigio, Sauvignon Blanc), and rosé. Both domestic and imported options available. Perfect for date night or catching up with friends. Dine-in only. Available at both North & West locations.

Saturday sangria special - $2 off all sangria pitchers and glasses all day. Choose from classic red sangria or refreshing white sangria, both made with fresh fruit, premium wine, and a splash of brandy. Served over ice. Available by the glass or pitcher. Dine-in only. Available at both North & West locations.

Weekend brunch menu available Saturday and Sunday from opening until 3pm. Features eggs benedict, pancakes, French toast, breakfast burritos, omelettes with your choice of fillings, and classic breakfast combos. Includes brunch cocktails like Caesar, Mimosa, and Bellini. Dine-in only. Available at both North & West locations.

Monday pints and riblets special all day. Original 16 or Onion Lager Pint for $5.99 and Ribs & Wings for $9.99. Tender ribs slow-cooked and basted with house BBQ sauce, served with fries and coleslaw. Great value for Monday night. Dine-in only.

Monday and Tuesday special featuring Vodka Paralyzers for $5.99 and classic Baked Lasagna for $13.99. Lasagna made with layers of pasta, rich meat sauce, ricotta, mozzarella, and parmesan, baked until golden and served with garlic toast. Paralyzers made with vodka, Kahlúa, Coke, and cream. Dine-in only.

deal_description: Thirsty Thursday featuring Long Island Iced Tea for $5.99 and Steak Sandwich for $16.99 all day. Tender steak sandwich served with your choice of side. Great value for Thursday night at The Onion. Dine-in only.

Monday special - $17 for a pulled pork sandwich paired with Russel Craft Lager. Slow-smoked pulled pork piled high on a toasted brioche bun, topped with coleslaw and crispy onion strings. Served with your choice of fries, salad, or coleslaw. Includes a full pint of Russel Craft Lager. Dine-in only.

Taco Tuesday featuring half-price tacos all day. Choose from chicken, beef, pork, or fish tacos served on soft flour or crispy corn tortillas with fresh toppings, salsa verde, and lime. Pair with Booze Buy drink specials: margaritas $8 or craft lager pints $6. Tacos ordered individually or in sets of 3. Dine-in or takeout.

Irish Wednesday featuring BBQ ribs at half price served with a pint of Guinness (25% off) and a shot of Jameson for $5. Slow-cooked ribs fall-off-the-bone tender and glazed with house-made BBQ sauce. Celebrate mid-week with this Irish-inspired combo special. Dine-in only.

Thirsty Thursday featuring classic nachos at half price paired with crafted Moscow Mules for $8. Nachos loaded with cheese, jalapeños, tomatoes, green onions, sour cream, and salsa. Choice of toppings available. Perfect combo for Thursday night. Dine-in only.

Friday Feeling - kick off the weekend with 25% off all whiskey varieties after 7pm and $5 bartender's choice shot. Choose from Canadian, American, Scotch, and Irish whiskey, bourbon, and rye. Available neat, on the rocks, or in classic cocktails like Old Fashioned, Whiskey Sour, or Manhattan. Rotating selection. Dine-in only.

Saturday Spirits - keep the weekend spirit alive with 25% off whiskey and $5 shots after 7pm. Same great whiskey selection and bartender's choice shots as Friday. Perfect for Saturday night out. Dine-in only.

Pizza Monday specials all day - $10 individual pizzas (signature recipes or create your own with up to 4 toppings). Options include Pepperoni, Hawaiian, Deluxe, Meat Lovers, Vegetarian, BBQ Chicken, and more. Hand-pressed dough with premium toppings and signature pizza sauce. Dine-in only. Available at both Lethbridge locations.

Pasta Tuesday specials all day starting at $11.99 on select pasta dishes. Choose from Spaghetti, Penne, Fettuccine Alfredo, Lasagna, Baked Seven Cheese Ravioli, Jambalaya Fettuccine, and more. All pasta dishes served with garlic toast. Add chicken, shrimp, or Italian sausage for extra protein. Dine-in only. Available at both Lethbridge locations.

Wing Wednesday - 50% off starter wings all day. Choose from over a dozen sauces and dry rubs including Buffalo, Honey Garlic, BBQ, Teriyaki, Thai Chili, Hot, Medium, Mild, Salt & Pepper, Cajun, Lemon Pepper, and more. Served with celery, carrots, and ranch or blue cheese dip. Available in different sizes (10, 20, or 30 wings). Dine-in only. Available at both Lethbridge locations.

Appetizer Thursday - Buy 2 appetizers, get the 3rd FREE all day. Choose from Spinach Dip, Potato Skins, Chicken Fingers, Nachos, Mozzarella Sticks, Onion Rings, Quesadillas, Baked Three Cheese Dip, and more. Perfect for sharing or as a meal. Dine-in only. Available at both Lethbridge locations.

Tuesday special featuring $2 Toonie Tacos after 2pm - choose from seasoned beef or chicken with toppings. Sub shrimp for +$2. Plus drink specials: $5 Corona bottles and $6 Paloma cocktails. Popular student night near University of Lethbridge campus. Dine-in only.

Wing Wednesday - 79¢ per wing (bone-in or boneless) after 2pm with purchase of a beverage. 10 wings per order. Choose from Buffalo, BBQ, Honey Garlic, Teriyaki, Hot, Medium, Mild, or Dry Cajun. No dip or veggies included. Plus drink specials: $5.75 Domestic Draft (Canadian/Kokanee) or $6.25 Premium Domestic (Rickards Red/Blue Moon) 16oz. Very popular with University of Lethbridge students. Arrive early or expect a wait. Dine-in only.

Taco Tuesday featuring $4 tacos from 4pm to close. Choose from Chipotle Lime Chicken Tacos or Cajun Shrimp Tacos served in soft flour or crispy corn tortillas. Plus $5.25 Coronas. Great value for taco lovers. Dine-in only.

Wing Thursday featuring 50% off wings from 4pm to close, plus $6 House Draft. Choose from bone-in or boneless wings tossed in your choice of sauce: Salt & Pepper, Lemon Pepper, Hot, BBQ, Honey Garlic, Bourbon, Sweet Chili, Spicy Southern Barbeque, or Teriyaki. Served with celery, carrots, and ranch or blue cheese dipping sauce. Dine-in only.

Taco Tuesday specials featuring discounted tacos all day. Choose from seasoned ground beef, grilled chicken, or refried bean tacos. Served in crispy corn or soft flour tortillas with lettuce, cheese, tomatoes, and signature sauces. Available in combos with sides and drinks. Dine-in, takeout, or drive-thru. Available at all Lethbridge locations.

Taco Tuesdaze at Blanco Cantina featuring 1/2 price classic tacos and $5 off premium tacos with beverage purchase. Classic: mojo pork, crispy fish, chicken tinga, braised beef, garlic mushroom, baja shrimp. Premium: diablo shrimp, pinche gringo, bulgogi steak, crispy cauliflower, jalisco hot chicken, quesabirria. Served with cabbage, onion, cilantro, jalapeño. Vibrant cantina atmosphere. Dine-in only.

Tuesday fish tacos for only $3 each. Crispy battered or grilled fish on soft flour tortillas with fresh cabbage slaw, pico de gallo, lime crema, and cilantro. Made with fresh Pacific cod. Order as many as you want. Great value for taco lovers. Available all day Tuesday. Dine-in or takeout.

Taco Thursday featuring discounted tacos all day. Choose from seasoned beef, grilled chicken, pork carnitas, or grilled vegetables. Served on soft flour or crispy corn tortillas with fresh toppings, salsa, and lime. Build your own taco bowl or order traditional tacos. Dine-in or takeout.

Tuesday discount on select menu items all day. Modern gastropub featuring elevated comfort food and craft cocktails. Discount applies to featured appetizers, mains, and select drinks. Check with server for today's Tuesday specials. Stylish industrial atmosphere with exposed brick and steel accents. Dine-in only.

Wednesday burger and brew special all day. Comes with fries or Caesar salad and a craft beer or domestic pint. Dine-in only. Available at both North & South locations.

Wing Thursday featuring 49¢ wings all day. Choose from bone-in or boneless tossed in your favorite sauce: Buffalo, Honey Garlic, BBQ, Teriyaki, Hot, Medium, Mild, Lemon Pepper, Cajun, or Thai Chili. Served with celery, carrots, and ranch or blue cheese dip. Order by the pound. Very popular - arrive early or expect a wait. Dine-in only. Available at both North & South locations.

Two-piece or three-piece options available. Classic pub favorite perfect for Friday night. Dine-in or takeout. Available at both North & South locations.

Pasta Saturday featuring $9.75 build your own pasta all day. Choose your pasta style and sauce. Options include Fettuccine Alfredo, Spaghetti Bolognese, Penne Arrabbiata, Carbonara, or Lasagna. All pasta dishes served with garlic toast and house salad. Add grilled chicken, shrimp, or Italian sausage for extra protein. Dine-in or takeout. Available at both North & South locations.

Steak Sunday featuring $10.95 steak sandwich special all day. Top sirloin steak served with fries, 2 onion rings, and warm garlic toast. Great value for a Sunday dinner. Topped with herb butter. Add sautéed mushrooms or peppercorn sauce for extra flavor. Dine-in only. Available at both North & South locations.

Daily food specials Monday through Wednesday from 2pm to close. Rotating menu featuring pub classics like burgers, sandwiches, wings, and mains at discounted prices. Check the board or ask your server for today's featured specials. Great value for weekday afternoons and evenings. Dine-in only.

Happy hour beverage specials Monday through Wednesday from 2pm to close. Discounted draft beer, domestic bottles, well drinks, and house wine. Perfect for after-work drinks or watching the game. Extended happy hour runs all the way to closing. Dine-in only.

Weekend happy hour Friday and Saturday from 2pm to 6pm featuring happy hour appetizer specials. Choose from wings, nachos, sliders, potato skins, mozzarella sticks, and more at discounted prices. Pair with drink specials for the perfect start to your weekend. Dine-in only.

Wing night every Thursday featuring discounted wings all night. Choose from bone-in or boneless tossed in classic pub sauces: Buffalo, BBQ, Honey Garlic, Teriyaki, Hot, Medium, Mild, or Dry Cajun. Served with celery, carrots, and ranch or blue cheese dip. Order by the pound. Local neighborhood pub atmosphere. Dine-in only.

Weekend brunch Saturday and Sunday from 7am to 2pm. Full brunch menu featuring eggs benedict, pancake stacks, French toast, breakfast skillets, omelettes, avocado toast, breakfast sandwiches, and classic breakfast combos. Fresh-baked pastries and specialty coffee drinks. Family-friendly atmosphere. Dine-in or takeout.

Pair with specialty espresso drinks, cappuccinos, lattes, or affogatos. Perfect late-night sweet treat or date night dessert. Cozy atmosphere ideal for lingering. Dine-in only.

Sunday brunch featuring Italian-inspired brunch dishes all day. Menu includes frittatas, Italian Benedict with prosciutto and poached eggs, ricotta pancakes, tiramisu French toast, breakfast pizza, caprese omelettes, and continental options. Pair with Mimosas, Bellinis, or Italian espresso drinks. Elegant casual atmosphere. Dine-in only.

Drink specials on house wine, prosecco, select cocktails, and Italian beer. Perfect for pre-dinner drinks or casual evening out. Check with server for daily times. Dine-in only.

Daily cocktail hour from 2pm to 5pm featuring 20% off all cocktails and beer. Extensive cocktail menu includes classics, signature creations, and seasonal features. Draft and bottled beer selection from local and international breweries. Upscale gastropub atmosphere with riverside views. Perfect for after-work drinks or weekend relaxation. Dine-in only.

Great value for lunch. Dine-in only.

Sports bar atmosphere with big screens and rooftop patio. Dine-in only.
